tasks.title: Heading drift without a compass
tasks.statement: The gyro bias on the yaw axis is **{w} °/s**. How far will the heading drift (°) in **{t} min** if nothing corrects it?

tasks.title: Constant Mahony error without an integrator
tasks.statement: A Mahony filter with **Kp = {kp}** and Ki = 0. The residual gyro bias in roll and pitch (vector magnitude) is **{b} °/s**. What constant tilt error (°) settles in hover?
tasks.solution: In steady state the Kp·e correction balances the bias: e = b/Kp (in radians; if b is in °/s, the answer comes out directly in degrees). The module's example: 0.583 °/s and Kp = 0.25 → 2.33°. The Ki integrator or gyro calibration removes this error.

tasks.title: False accelerometer tilt during acceleration
tasks.statement: A copter accelerates horizontally at **{a} m/s²**. By how many degrees is the tilt computed from the accelerometer alone wrong (g = 9.81 m/s²)?
tasks.solution: The accelerometer sees the specific force f = a − g; its direction is tilted from vertical by atan(a/g). At 4 m/s² that is 22.2°, while |f| = 1.08 g is still inside the Betaflight 0.9–1.1 g window.

tasks.title: Acceleration magnitude in a coordinated turn
tasks.statement: A plane flies a coordinated turn banked **{phi}°**. What specific-force magnitude (in g) will the accelerometer show? Check yourself whether it passes the Betaflight 0.9–1.1 g window.
tasks.solution: In a coordinated turn the resultant force points along the vehicle's Z axis: |f| = g/cos φ, and the accelerometer tilt is 0°. At 30° it is 1.155 g (outside the window), at 25° 1.103 g (just outside the window), at 20° 1.064 g (inside the window: Betaflight will accept the false horizon).
